newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss franc bonds closed somewhat lower under pressure from signs of Swiss economic revival including lower June unemployment, traders said.
Traders said the June jobless decline to 5.1 percent from 5.3 percent in May reinforced recent retail sales data that also suggested a slight improvement in Europe's most sluggish economy.
"This prompted some profit-taking and pushed prices down," one trader said.
The mood was reinforced by a forecast from the Swiss Chamber of Commerce and Industry, which said conditions were set for a gradual economic recovery, traders said.
Conf futures CONFc1 down 32 at 121.60 pct.
Comi medium-term bond COMIc1 down eight at 113.80.
Euro Swiss francs FESc1 down nine at 98.44.
